# E0327: constants in a cycle

A constant's value can't depend on itself. Give one of them a value that doesn't refer back.

- Rule: [`declarations.constant-cycles`](../../reference/10-declarations.md#declarations.constant-cycles)
- Reported at: the name of the last constant of the cycle (errors.several-places).
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0327:2
const WIDTH: i64 = HEIGHT
const HEIGHT: i64 = WIDTH
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
const WIDTH: i64 = 80
const HEIGHT: i64 = WIDTH
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0327_constants_in_a_cycle.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0327_constants_in_a_cycle.lt):

```text
── CONSTANTS IN A CYCLE ───────────── E0327_constants_in_a_cycle.lt:2:7  [E0327]

These constants refer to each other in a cycle:

  2 │ const HEIGHT: i64 = WIDTH
    │       ^^^^^^

A constant's value can't depend on itself. Give one of them a value that doesn't
refer back.
```
